screw.intro: Yana tuƙa turmai atomatik: makanikin lantarki mai bit na magnetic a ramin spindle yana ɗaukar turmi daga loader, yana motsi zuwa kowane maki na nufi, kuma yana juyawa (M3) don tuƙa shi zuwa zurfi. Ƙara maki daga wurin na'ura mai rai; shirin yana daidaitawa atomatik da tab na Shiri don yawowa.

screw.loader.title: Loader na turmi
screw.loader.body: Inda ake ɗaukar turmi. Bit na magnetic yana hanzari zuwa wannan XY, yana feed ƙasa zuwa pick Z, kuma yana tsayawa don magnet ya kama turmi kafin janyewa.

screw.driver.title: Makanikin lantarki
screw.driver.body: Fitar spindle shi ne makanikin lantarki. M3 S<rpm> yana juya shi don TUƘA turmi ciki; M5 yana tsayar. Push feed shi ne yadda sauri ake tuƙa turmi ƙasa; tsayawar zama tana riƙe a zurfi don turmi ya zauna.
screw.field.driverRPM.body: Kalmar saurin spindle (S) da ke juya makanikin lantarki yayin tuƙawa (M3).
screw.field.pushFeed.body: Saurin turawa — plunge feed na Z yayin tuƙa turmi ƙasa cikin aiki.
screw.field.approachFeed.body: Ƙimar feed don saukowa a loader yayin ɗaukar turmi.
screw.field.seatDwell.body: Tsayawa a zurfin ƙarshe don turmi ya zauna kafin driver ya tsaya kuma ya janye (daƙiƙa).

screw.motion.body: Tsohuwar zurfin saka turmi kowane-maki (korau = cikin aiki), tsayin janyewar Safe-Z da aka tabbatar, da daidaiton tsarin da aka fitar.

spring.title: Lanƙwasa Spring
spring.intro: Yana lanƙwasa coil spring a kan coiler na atomatik na ƙusoshi-2: chuck mai juyawa yana juya mandrel (kowane juyi = juyi ɗaya na spring) yayin da carriage mai layi da aka daidaita ke ci gaba bisa pitch (A = digiri na chuck, X = mm na carriage). Zaɓi nau'in spring, saita girman wire/coil, juyi da pitch; shirin ƙusoshi-2 yana daidaitawa atomatik da tab na Shiri don yawowa.
spring.toolbar.hw.body: Daidaita kayan aiki (stepper steps/rev, microstepping, gear ratio, leadscrew lead) — saita sau ɗaya idan an gina na'ura ko drivetrain nata ya canza.
spring.toolbar.home.body: Home ƙusoshin carriage mai layi: yana neman home limit switch nasa kuma yana sake sifirtawa (yana aika $H zuwa ƙusoshin carriage).

spring.count.reset.title: Sake saita ƙidaya zuwa sifiri
spring.type.title: Nau'in spring
spring.type.body: Spring na matsawa suna da rufaffu (murabba'in) ƙarshe da pitch na jiki mai buɗewa. Spring na shimfiɗa da torsion ana lanƙwasa su da coil masu ɗauri, masu taɓa juna ko'ina (pitch ≈ diamita na wire) — ana ƙara hooks/ƙafafu da hannu. Na'ura tana lanƙwasa coil da chuck mai juyawa + carriage mai layi da aka daidaita (kawai fitarwa).
spring.type.compression.body: Rufaffu ƙarshe, pitch na jiki mai buɗewa
spring.type.extension.body: Coil masu ɗauri ko'ina; ana yin hooks da hannu
spring.type.torsion.body: Coil masu ɗauri ko'ina; ana yin ƙafafu da hannu
spring.note.tight: Coil masu ɗauri — an kulle pitch na jiki zuwa diamita na wire. Ana yin hooks/ƙafafu da hannu bayan lanƙwasawa.
spring.geom.title: Geometry
spring.geom.body: Diamita na wire da MATSAKAICIN diamita na coil (diamita da tsakiyar wire ke zana ≈ diamita na mandrel + diamita na wire). Juyin jiki su ne juyi masu aiki da aka lanƙwasa a pitch na jiki; pitch shi ne ci gaba na axial kowane juyi.
spring.field.wireDia.body: Diamita na wire (mm). Coil masu rufewa/ɗauri suna amfani da wannan a matsayin pitch don coil su taɓa.
spring.field.coilDia.body: Matsakaicin diamita na coil (mm) — diamita da tsakiyar wire ke zana. Radius na helix na 3D rabin wannan ne.
spring.field.bodyTurns.body: Juyi masu aiki da aka lanƙwasa a pitch na jiki (juyi ɗaya na chuck = juyi ɗaya).
spring.field.pitch.body: Ci gaba na axial kowane juyi a jiki (mm). An kulle zuwa diamita na wire don spring na shimfiɗa/torsion masu ɗauri.
spring.close.title: Juyin rufewa
spring.close.body: Juyi rufaffu (matattu) a kowane ƙarshe inda pitch ≈ diamita na wire don coil su taɓa — murabba'in ƙarshen spring na matsawa. Spring na shimfiɗa/torsion rufaffu ne ko'ina, don haka juyin rufewa ba sa aiki.
spring.close.na: Ba ya aiki — ana lanƙwasa wannan nau'in spring da coil masu ɗauri ƙarshe-zuwa-ƙarshe.
spring.field.closeStart.body: Juyi masu ɗauri, masu taɓa juna a ƙarshen FARKO (pitch = diamita na wire).
spring.field.closeEnd.body: Juyi masu ɗauri, masu taɓa juna a ƙarshen ƘARSHE (pitch = diamita na wire).
spring.field.releaseTurns.body: Bayan lanƙwasawa, chuck yana juyawa baya wannan adadin juyi (carriage yana tsaye) don sassauta matsin da aka lanƙwasa har spring da aka gama ya zame daga mandrel. 0 = babu.
spring.motion.title: Motsi
spring.motion.body: Saurin chuck (rev/min) yana saita ƙimar lanƙwasawa; ana samun feed na carriage mai layi daga gare shi da pitch don ƙusoshin biyu su zauna a daidaitacce. Segments/rev yana sarrafa yadda kowane juyi ke rabuwa da kyau don motsi mai daidaitacce mai laushi. Adadi-goma yana saita daidaiton tsarin da aka fitar.
spring.field.rpm.body: Saurin juyawar chuck (rev/min). Feed mai layi da aka daidaita = sauri × pitch.
spring.field.segs.body: Motsi nawa masu daidaitawa suka haɗu da kowane juyi (mafi girma = motsi mai laushi + shiri mafi girma).
spring.field.decimals.body: Adadin wuraren adadi-goma a tsarin da aka fitar (0–6).

spring.hw.intro: Daidaita drivetrain don WANNAN coiler. Saita waɗannan sau ɗaya idan an gina na'ura ko motoci/gearing/leadscrew nata sun canza — ba kowane spring ba. Steps/° da steps/mm da aka samu su ne abin da controller ke buƙata (GRBL $100/$101).
spring.field.rotaryAxis.body: Wace ƙusoshin controller ce stepper na chuck/juyawa ke wayar zuwa. Allon GRBL na ƙusoshi-3 na matsayi yana da X/Y/Z kawai — zaɓi A kawai a kan allon grblHAL/FluidNC na ƙusoshi-4. Dole ya bambanta da ƙusoshin carriage.
